# Club Seating Information
## Club Seating Information

# Club Seating Information  
##  Club Seating Information  
####  
PNC Champions Club  
As the newest addition to Acrisure Stadium's club spaces, the PNC Champions Club boasts stunning field-level views of the game and includes five field club level sections and three 100-level South end zone sections. The ticketed seats are located outside, in the seating bowl, but tickets include access to the PNC Champions Club. Inside the club space, guests will find exclusive Ã la carte concession options, merchandise items, restrooms, and the "Chief's Room," a classic, fully-stocked bar with booth seating, a fireplace and floor-to-ceiling window views of the players' tunnel.  
####  
North Club Lounge

## Club Seating Information

####  
North Club Lounge  
As the smallest club space in Acrisure Stadium, the North Club Lounge provides a more private atmosphere on gameday. The ticketed seating options include two rows (rows A and B) of outdoor seats and Acrisure Stadium's only indoor row of seats (row C). The North Club Lounge access includes the indoor lounge space, Ã la carte concessions, main bar and restrooms. From the lounge space, guests will have a spectacular view of the field, main scoreboard and downtown Pittsburgh from the third level of the stadium.  
####  
UPMC Club Lounge

## Club Seating Information

####  
UPMC Club Lounge  
The UPMC Club Lounge extends across the eastern half of Acrisure Stadium from Gate B to Gate A East. From the indoor lounge space, guests can view downtown Pittsburgh through the two-story glass windows while enjoying Ã la carte concession options, the modern-style main bar and soft-seating lounge areas. The club space also includes restrooms and merchandise items. Enjoy a pregame snack in the air-conditioning during sunny gamedays or escape the cold for a time-out toward the end of the season. The UPMC Club Lounge has a sister club, the West Club Lounge, which can also be accessed with a UPMC Club Lounge ticket.  
####  
West Club Lounge

## Club Seating Information

####  
West Club Lounge  
The West Club Lounge provides guests with views of Mt. Washington and the Ohio River that become a perfect backdrop during a vibrant fall sunset. The indoor lounge space includes access to Ã la carte concession options, the modern-style main bar and soft-seating lounge areas. The club space also includes restrooms and merchandise items. As the sister club to the UPMC Club Lounge, all tickets to the West Club Lounge grant access to the UPMC Club Lounge as well. This combination allows guests to visit each other in both club spaces throughout the duration of the game.
